title: 综合练习
instruction:
创建一个自我介绍程序。

1. 存储名字：name = "Tom"
2. 存储年龄：age = 18
3. 存储身高：height = 1.75
4. 输出：Tom is 18 years old, 1.75m tall
hint: 用 f-string 或字符串拼接都可以
starter:
name = "Tom"
age = 18
height = 1.75
# 请在下面写出输出代码
answer:
name = "Tom"
age = 18
height = 1.75
print(f"{name} is {age} years old, {height}m tall")
encouragement: 完美！你掌握了变量的基本用法！
